gloss: picture card; face card (in playing cards: jack, queen, king)

definitions.gloss: picture card; face card (in playing cards: jack, queen, king)
illustrated card; picture tag (in traditional Japanese card games)

examples.japanese: {絵札|えふだ}は10{点|てん}として{数|かぞ}える。
トランプの{絵札|えふだ}にはジャック、クイーン、キングがある。
examples.english: The face cards in a deck of playing cards are the jack, queen, and king.

examples.japanese: ブラックジャックでは{絵札|えふだ}はすべて10の{価値|かち}がある。
examples.english: In blackjack, all face cards are worth 10.

examples.japanese: かるたの{絵札|えふだ}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: Lay out the picture cards for karuta.

examples.japanese: {花札|はなふだ}の{絵札|えふだ}には{美|うつく}しい{日本画|にほんが}が{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: The picture cards in hanafuda have beautiful Japanese paintings on them.

examples.japanese: {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}の{絵札|えふだ}には{歌人|かじん}の{姿|すがた}が{描|えが}かれており、{読|よ}み{札|ふだ}と{対|つい}になっている。
examples.english: The picture cards in Hyakunin Isshu depict the poets, and they are paired with the reading cards.

notes:
Has two related uses: for Western playing cards, it refers to the face cards (jack, queen, king); for traditional Japanese card games, it refers to the illustrated cards used in games like {花札|はなふだ}, かるた, and {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トランプの{絵札|えふだ}: playing card face cards
- かるたの{絵札|えふだ}: karuta picture cards
- {花札|はなふだ}の{絵札|えふだ}: hanafuda picture cards
- {絵札|えふだ}を{取|と}る: to grab a picture card (in karuta)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {数札|かずふだ}: number cards — the cards without pictures (ace through 10 in Western cards)
- {読|よ}み{札|ふだ}: reading card — in karuta, the card that is read aloud (paired with the picture card)
- {取|と}り{札|ふだ}: grabbing card — in karuta, the card players grab from the floor
